headline: Former Obafemi Awolowo University Vice-Chancellor Wale Omole Dies
seoTitle: Ex-OAU Vice-Chancellor Wale Omole Passes Away
metaDescription: Obafemi Awolowo University has announced the passing of former Vice-Chancellor Prof. Wale Omole, who held the leadership position from 1991 to 1999.
aiSummaryBullets: Professor Wale Omole, a former Vice-Chancellor of Obafemi Awolowo University, has died at the age of 84.
He served as the university's Vice-Chancellor during an eight-year tenure spanning from 1991 to 1999.
Omole established a long-term academic career at the institution, rising from assistant lecturer to Professor of Animal Science in 1980.
aiContextParagraph: Obafemi Awolowo University, located in Ile-Ife, Nigeria, has officially acknowledged the death of Professor Wale Omole. Omole was a prominent figure within the university's history, having climbed the academic ranks within the institution over several decades. He began his tenure at the school as an assistant lecturer before attaining the rank of Professor of Animal Science in 1980. Following his academic progression, he took on the role of Vice-Chancellor, serving in the university's top administrative capacity from 1991 until 1999. His passing at age 84 marks the conclusion of a significant chapter for the university community. Both national outlets reporting on the event focused on his historical impact on the institution and his lengthy tenure in academic leadership. The university has issued formal statements expressing mourning for the late scholar and former administrator.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained visibility through multiple independent news outlets reporting on the passing of a notable former academic leader.
